description: Publish (crosspost) a message from an Announcement channel to every server that follows it. Only works in announcement channels on a message that has not already been published. Requires the Send Messages permission (and Manage Messages for messages authored by others). Returns a confirmation.

channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the announcement channel containing the message.

message_id.description: ID of the message to publish to followers.

name: discord_crosspost_message
